title: Working on some frosty weapon icons in LibreSprite for an RPG inventory system. What do you think of the crystal details?
author: LoreCraft_Assets
selftext:
>Hey everyone! Just sharing a quick snapshot of my current workflow in LibreSprite while designing this "Frostbite Twin Blades" icon.  
>  
>I really wanted to capture that cold, crystalline texture on the crossguard and blades while keeping the pixel clusters clean enough for a 128px UI slot.  
>  
>For those of you who work with pixel art inventories, how do you usually approach adding magical or elemental glowing effects without making the sprite look too noisy? Would love to hear your thoughts or tips!
